facts.fact: The East African Communications Organisation report lists Kenya, through its regulator CA, as one of the seven member states whose regulators submit data to EACO; no event date is given, so the report's published date is used.

EACO publishes Kenya's One Network Area cross-border voice figures for 2025: inbound 461.5 million minutes (+19.2%) and outbound 603.5 million minutes (+23.9%, the largest in the region), with roaming tariffs reduced under the ONA Project.
